changelog:
🔁 A request moves to another account when Kiro refuses the model for one account, instead of failing; account weight is capped at 100 so a huge value can no longer stall or crash the server.
🔎 Hosted web search: text written before a search is kept, search rounds no longer run together, result dates read as dates, and a search counts as the tool call tool_choice requires.
📏 An over-long input is reported the way clients detect it: "prompt is too long" on the Anthropic API and context_length_exceeded on the OpenAI APIs, so Claude Code can compact.
✨ Many small UI fixes: sizes as KB, MB and GB, ∞ for an unset per-minute limit, true minus signs, full text in tooltips where it is cut off, singular counts, clearer durations and wording.
